title: 2019 Panini Prestige - Rookie #244 Dexter Williams (RC) Green Bay Packers

descriptionText:
This 2019 Panini Prestige sports trading card features Dexter Williams, a rookie player for the Green Bay Packers. With a card number of 244, this card is a part of the base set and is perfect for any NFL fan or sports trading card collector. The card is manufactured by Panini and is a great addition to any collection. 

The card is a National Football League (NFL) product and is not autographed. It is a single trading card and is categorized under Trading Card Singles, Sports Trading Cards, and Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop. The season for this card is 2019 and it is a must-have for any football enthusiast.
